reason: The README describes a token usage and cost monitoring plugin with persistent accounting, dynamic pricing retrieval, budget alerts, optional model-call blocking, and a web dashboard.

summaries.zh: 用于统计对话 Token 用量与费用、跟踪预算状态，并通过仪表盘查看汇总数据的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for tracking conversation token usage and costs, monitoring budgets, and viewing aggregated data in a web dashboard.

capabilities: Tracks and aggregates token usage and estimated costs
Persists usage and pricing data to a ledger file
Fetches and parses external provider pricing pages
Provides a web dashboard and JSON API
Warns on budget thresholds and can block model calls after budget limits are exceeded
